Domains match the accepted graph; constraints (n >= 1, positivity, K >= 1, network conditions) belong to the setup unit.

Every declaration takes the single Public record q, so G, W, lam, eta, K, x0 are bound consistently across mix, localBase, innerStep, direction, step and dobocK. localOracle q f x binds reply component i to f i evaluated at block x i, and iterate feeds localOracle at the current iterate; inner steps reuse the same x and r.

dobocK : Algorithm (Stacked) (LocalReply) (Stacked) 1: initial x0, one query of oracle 0 at the current iterate per outer iteration, K - 1 inner rounds computed from that reply, update x - ghat_{K-1}, output the current state. Matches Algorithm 2; K = 1 gives x - eta grad F(x) (distributed gradient descent, line 306). Communication rounds are simulated by mix over N_i u {i}, preserving the neighbour-only information pattern. The template's execute with budget k performs k query/update pairs, so the output is x_k (to be proved as execute_dobocK).
Deterministic: Seed defaults to Unit with the Dirac law (dobocK._proof_1 is IsProbabilityMeasure (dirac ())); verified (dobocK q).Seed = Unit by rfl. Matches the deterministic source.
No convergence claim in this unit; output = last iterate, the object of Theorem 2's rate, and iterate provides x_k for the convergence unit.

Hessian represented as fderiv R (gradient (f i)) (x i) : E ->L[R] E applied to g i, gradient via Mathlib's gradient on EuclideanSpace (Riesz representative w.r.t. the Euclidean inner product), stacked vectors via PiLp 2: faithful representations of the source's grad f_i, grad^2 f_i and R^{np}.

Providers are standard Mathlib structures (PiLp/WithLp.toLp, EuclideanSpace, gradient, fderiv, SimpleGraph.neighborFinset, Finset.sum, Nat.iterate, ContinuousLinearMap) plus Template.Algorithm; localOracle._proof_1 is the CompleteSpace instance needed by gradient. Their meanings are the standard ones used above.
